2116520245741355336.en_summary: Tae Kim plays Bill Ackman role: White House needs to realize financial conditions tightening as markets deteriorate, Soros reflexivity. Credit and equity funding may dry up despite solid fundamentals. At end of runway on $110+ oil, inflation and rates. Need credible Iran war resolution now to lower energy prices/inflation/rates or risk senseless self-inflicted recession.
2116520245741355336.zh_summary: Tae Kim扮演Bill Ackman角色：白宮需要意識到金融狀況正在收緊，因市場惡化，索羅斯反射性在起作用。盡管基本面穩固，信貸和股權融資可能枯竭。在110美元以上油價、通脹和利率的跑道盡頭。現在需要可信的伊朗戰爭解決方案以降低能源價格/通脹/利率，否則風險是歷史上最無意義的自作自受衰退。

2116514754542121024.en_summary: Danielle DiMartino Booth says credit is always at the core. Arini Capital Management beset with losses this month has gotten bids on some high-yield debt holdings from asset managers including @PIMCO & @Oaktree. Quotes WSJ on Arini’s $7B fund down over 20% dumping easy-to-sell stuff to cover margin calls.
2116514754542121024.zh_summary: Danielle DiMartino Booth說信貸始終是核心。Arini Capital Management本月遭受損失，已從包括@PIMCO和@Oaktree在內的資產管理人處獲得部分高收益債務持倉的出價。引用WSJ指Arini約70億美元基金今年迄今下跌超過20%，正在拋售容易出售的東西以覆蓋保證金追繳。
